description: Make user-authorized phone calls and retrieve their status and results.

interface.longDescription: DialAgent is a communication tool for delegating phone tasks from ChatGPT. Ask it to call a restaurant to request a table reservation or call a business to ask about availability and opening hours. You provide the phone number, purpose and permission to call. DialAgent places the call using your connected account and authorized caller ID, then lets you check its status and retrieve the outcome and available transcript. Reservations are confirmed only when the recipient explicitly accepts them; successful connection alone does not mean the task succeeded. Sign-in and caller-ID setup are required. Calls are limited to 10 minutes. Transcripts may be partial. Audio recordings are not provided. Status and results are returned as text in ChatGPT; custom UI cards are currently disabled.
defaultPrompt: Check my DialAgent setup without starting a call.
Show the status and result of my latest call.
capabilities: Retrieve call results and available transcripts
